about: Spell and cantrip tier ratings, read from the [Updated] Patch 8 spell series in playlist PLgTVc5Jd2rrLPuc3vE6XqK65QQboFfolP. One row per spell per source video. Feeds tier/tier_note on the spells blocks in content/characters/*.md.
method: tools/dump_tier_verdicts.py lists every spoken verdict; each was read and attributed by hand. The lists state their own totals on camera ("26 of the 52 first level spells"), which is the completeness check.
scale: S A B C D. This series defines no F tier, so a reported F is a mis-hear.
